job.job_description:
Python Dev

AI Engineer 3–7 Years

Location: Gurgaon (First Preference) / Hyderabad
Work Model: 4 Days WFO + 1 Day WFH
Joining: Immediate Joiners Preferred

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer with 5–7 years of experience with strong hands-on expertise in Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, Prompt Engineering, LangChain and LangGraph. The candidate should have strong Python programming and the ability to design and implement production-ready AI solutions.

Primary Skills

Strong Python programming, logical reasoning and problem-solving
Strong understanding of LLMs and Generative AI
RAG architecture and implementation
Prompt Engineering
Embeddings & Vector Search
Hands-on experience with LangChain & LangGraph
AI/ML model development, evaluation and optimization
Supervised & Unsupervised Learning fundamentals
API development and integration
Experience building production-grade AI solutions

Good to Have

Agentic AI / AI Agents
Docker & Kubernetes
AWS / Azure
Git, Jenkins / CI-CD
Microservices
Swagger
Keycloak
Elasticsearch & Kibana
Nexus / artifact management
Model / Agent monitoring

Key Responsibilities

Design and develop scalable Generative AI and LLM-based applications.
Build and optimize RAG pipelines, embeddings and vector search solutions.
Develop complex AI workflows using LangChain and LangGraph.
Design AI agents and agentic workflows where applicable.
Develop and integrate APIs for AI/ML applications.
Evaluate and optimize LLM/model performance and output quality.
Work with engineering teams on deployment, CI/CD and productionization.
Contribute to architecture, technical design and best practices for AI solutions.
Troubleshoot AI application issues and improve reliability and performance.
